hidden_nurse_d2_low.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_low.text: *When I open the nurse's office door, the school nurse closes the chart she was reading.* Unless it's treatment you really need, it's hard to talk for long right now. Go on back to class.

hidden_nurse_d2_neg.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_neg.text: *She snaps the chart shut and points toward the door.* If there's no more treatment for you today, just go.

after2_start.name: {name}
after2_start.text: *The classroom after the final homeroom period. My phone buzzes briefly in my pocket, and two new notifications appear side by side.*

after2_msg_dain.name: Dain
after2_msg_dain.text: Get over to the gym, now! Today's bet is the real thing.

after2_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
after2_msg_seo.text: Can you come by the council room for a minute after school? I'm a bit short-handed today.

after2_msg_yuna.name: {name}
after2_msg_yuna.text: *No separate message from Yuna. Instead, my fingertips trace the five characters on this morning's note in my pocket, "library annex."*

after2_nurse_transition.name: {name}
after2_nurse_transition.text: *The corner of the elbow bandage from after 5th-period PE keeps catching. Even if I press it down with my fingertips, it lifts again right away.*

hidden_nurse_d2_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_1.text: *I stop by the nurse's office and roll up my sleeve. One end of the bandage is half lifted. Luckily, no more blood is seeping from the wound.*

hidden_nurse_d2_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_2.text: Huh. Not even half a day on, and the bandage came back as a return. Come over here and sit.

hidden_nurse_d2_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_3.text: While I was moving around, the end of the bandage kept catching on my shirt sleeve.

hidden_nurse_d2_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_4.text: Hold your arm out this way. Let me see.

hidden_nurse_d2_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_5.text: *The school nurse peels off the loose bandage, wipes around the wound with antiseptic cotton, and takes out a fresh one.* This'll sting a little again.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.text: *The school nurse wraps a hand around my wrist and slowly bends and straightens my elbow, gauging the angle for the new bandage.*
choices: Did you learn things like this at the hospital?
You're meticulous even with a bandage.
You only take this much care with me, right?
Getting hurt doesn’t seem so bad if you’re the one treating me.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.text: Yeah. A joint that never stays still has to go on along the grain of the skin, or it'll peel the moment you move.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.text: Of course. This is my job. If I slap it on and send you off, and it falls off again in class, you're the one who suffers.

hidden_nurse_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_6.text: *She drops the new bandage wrapper into the bin. The desk drawer she hurriedly shut earlier is still locked.*

hidden_nurse_d2_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_7.text: *She notices my eyes on the drawer and rests a palm on the handle.* That drawer talk ended earlier. No matter how much you look, I'm not opening it.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.text: *A faint tension goes into the school nurse's pale knuckles around the drawer handle.*
choices: You sure have a lot of secrets. Can't you tell me just one?
Right, I didn't see anything
If it’s your secret, I promise I’ll keep it.
You can tell me everything.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.text: *She taps the front of the closed drawer with one finger.* If I already told you the secret that I like cocoa, that's enough. No more secrets for today.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.text: *With a soft smile, she takes her hand off the drawer handle.* Right. A secret just between the two of us is enough, isn't it?

hidden_nurse_d2_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_8.text: There. I put this one on much tighter. Tonight, really keep the water off it.

after2_choice.name: {name}
after2_choice.text: *After school, as the sunset starts to color the sky, where do I head?*
choices: To the gym (Dain)
To the student council room (Seoyeon)
Stop by the library annex (Yuna)

after2_dain_1.name: {name}
after2_dain_1.text: *I open the gym door. The floorboards ring, and there's Dain, lightly loosening up in front of the volleyball net.*

after2_dain_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_2.text: Oh, finally here? Busted. You're late!

after2_dain_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_3.text: Look at the clock. I got here a whole 5 minutes early.

after2_dain_4.name: Dain
after2_dain_4.text: I knew you'd come, so I've been waiting since 10 minutes ago!

after2_dain_5.name: {name}
after2_dain_5.text: *You're the impatient one who came early. I'm not the one who's late.*

after2_dain_6.name: Dain
after2_dain_6.text: Let's get into the real game! If you get three or more in out of five serves, you win! If you can't clear it, you buy the tteokbokki in front of school!

after2_dain_7.name: {name}
after2_dain_7.text: The penalty for losing is tteokbokki, out of nowhere?

after2_dain_8.name: Dain
after2_dain_8.text: I already ran, so I'm hungry! Here, I'm receiving!

after2_dain_9.name: {name}
after2_dain_9.text: *My first serve catches in the net, but once I get a feel for it, the second ball shoots inside the court's boundary line.*

after2_dain_9_b.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_b.text: *She snatches the bouncing ball in both hands, her eyes widening.* Huh? I had you down as a beginner and was going to go easy. That almost got serious.

after2_dain_9_c.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_c.text: That could've just been a lucky hit. We'll have to play to see if you've really got the skills! *She lowers her stance and tightens her grip on the volleyball.*

after2_dain_9_d.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_d.text: All right, light serve practice ends here! From now on it's a continuous rally. First to three points wins!

after2_dain_9_e.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_e.text: *Through the rally, I watch. Every time Dain lands, her left foot comes down first, and she sets her right foot down, half a beat later.*

after2_dain_9_f.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_f.text: Hah, hah... Match over at 3:2! *Still gasping, Dain gets up, rubs her right knee once without thinking, and flips the scoreboard.*

after2_dain_12.name: Dain
after2_dain_12.text: Ah, I lost by a hair! But your form hitting the ball isn't ordinary. Didn't you tell me you don't do sports?

after2_dain_13.name: {name}
after2_dain_13.text: I never said, in my own words, that I don't do sports at all.

after2_dain_14.name: Dain
after2_dain_14.text: *Her eyes go wide enough that the volleyball tucked under her arm drops to the floor with a thud.* What, so I was the only one who got completely fooled?

after2_dain_15.name: {name}
after2_dain_15.text: I didn't trick you. You never actually asked me first.

after2_dain_16.name: Dain
after2_dain_16.text: *She raises a fist, then gives a short laugh and tucks it against her side.* You sly little fraud. It's been forever since I had fun that actually made me sweat!

after2_dain_skinship_1.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_1.text: Nice rally! You kept receiving like that, so I got even more into it. *Dain's hot palm hits mine and only leaves my hand a beat later.*

after2_dain_skinship_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_2.text: Ah, sorry. Is your palm stinging? I got so into it I forgot to hold back.

after2_dain_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_skinship_3.text: *Beads of sweat gather along Dain's collarbone as she rubs the palm that just met mine against the side seam of her track pants, for no real reason.*

after2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after2_dain_freetalk.text: *After we step into the shop, she pushes the tteokbokki cup closer and lifts her chopsticks.* Let's see how well you handle spicy food.

after2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_b.text: *The snack shop in front of school, the sweet smell of chili paste spreading. Dain picks up one red rice cake, purses her lips, and blows on it to cool it.*

after2_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2.text: Hey, come clean. You used to train sports pretty seriously, right?

after2_dain_end_2b.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_2b.text: Just a little, back when I was a kid.

after2_dain_end_2c.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2c.text: Come on. Someone who only learned a little couldn't receive my spike like that! Admit it. You're good at sports.

after2_dain_end_2d.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_2d.text: From where I was standing, you were hitting a hundred times cooler.

after2_dain_end_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3.text: Since when have you been that good at volleyball? That wasn't just a hobby. *For a second, the tip of Dain's chopsticks pauses at the rim of the tteokbokki cup.*

after2_dain_end_3b.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3b.text: Of course. I originally got in recruited for volleyball.

after2_dain_end_3c.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3c.text: *The moment the past tense in "got in" finishes, Dain's hand shoots to the cold water cup beside the paper cup.*

after2_dain_end_3d.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3d.text: Tss, ah, spicy! Water, water, hurry!

after2_dain_end_3e.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3e.text: Hey {name}, any more cold water? Feels like my mouth's on fire! *Fanning her stinging lips, she pushes the tteokbokki cup over toward me.*

after2_dain_rival_seo_high.name: Seoyeon
after2_dain_rival_seo_high.text: *Seoyeon stops outside the snack shop's large window. She sees the two cups of tteokbokki facing each other, and a message arrives almost at once.* You went to the gym after school today. Don't forget to drop by the council room next time, too.

after2_dain_rival_seo_mid.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_seo_mid.text: *Passing the shop, Seoyeon spots our table through the window. She adjusts the corners of the clipboard against her chest twice, then walks silently away toward the school gate.*

after2_dain_rival_seo_low.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon gives us a small nod through the snack shop window as she passes, without slowing her steps.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_high.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_high.text: *Yuna watches us through the shop window. She pushes the folded note between her fingers deep into her pocket, then turns away.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_mid.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_mid.text: *Yuna starts to take out an earbud when she sees me outside the snack shop, then notices Dain opposite me and quietly puts it back in.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_low.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_low.text: *Yuna gives a brief nod through the window, then turns toward the library annex.*

after2_seo_1.name: {name}
after2_seo_1.text: *The quiet council room after school. Seoyeon sits alone in front of a pile of papers on the long meeting table, moving her pen.*

after2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_2.text: You actually came. — Honestly, I thought you'd say you were busy and not show.

after2_seo_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_3.text: You called me yourself. Of course I'd come.

after2_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_4.text: Good thing I worked up the nerve to call you.

after2_seo_4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_4_b.text: Here, {name}. From this list, pick what you want to take on first. *She pulls a chair out toward me and turns the clipboard around.*

after2_seo_5.name: {name}
after2_seo_5.text: You're the one who called me for being short-handed, and now you're giving me a choice.

after2_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_6.text: It's a special courtesy because I'm grateful you came when I asked.

after2_seo_6_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_6_b.text: Spring semester event budgets, and a bundle of club applications. Which should I start on?

after2_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8.text: Line the budgets up by date, and sort those by club. — Have you done this kind of paperwork before?

after2_seo_8a2.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a2.text: I'm not great at it, but I don't make a mess of it either.

after2_seo_8a4.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a4.text: About the same as how you usually compliment people. You always talk around it, vaguely.

after2_seo_8b.name: {name}
after2_seo_8b.text: I'm working hard to help you. Couldn't you spare a little praise? *The fingertips turning the papers stop, and Seoyeon's eyes, past her glasses, turn toward me.*

after2_seo_8b2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b2.text: Your hands are quite a bit faster and more accurate than I thought.

after2_seo_8b3.name: {name}
after2_seo_8b3.text: Can I count that as an official compliment?

after2_seo_8b4.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4.text: Yes. That's a top-grade compliment. Take it and be grateful.

after2_seo_8b4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4_b.text: *She calls it a compliment, then drops her eyes and squares the corners of the papers. She tugs at the shirt collar under the flushed nape.*

after2_seo_choice1.name: {name}
after2_seo_choice1.text: *Orange sunset pouring through the half-open blinds warms the papers on the desk and the side of Seoyeon's face.*
choices: The sunset's nice. — I mean the view, of course.
If you do this every day, you must be used to it.
Don’t struggle on your own. Want me to finish it for you?
That’s enough. Do the rest tomorrow.

after2_seo_sunset_joke.name: {name}
after2_seo_sunset_joke.text: I should make it clear that I'm talking about the sunset outside. We wouldn't want any misunderstandings. *Seoyeon's glasses slip toward the tip of her nose, and the pen skids outside the date box.*

after2_seo_sunset_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react.text: ...Who said anything? Adding all that on purpose makes it much more suspicious.

after2_seo_neck_worry.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_worry.text: I'm fine. This much paperwork is just everyday for me.

after2_seo_neck_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_react.text: *Even as she says that, she slowly rolls a stiff shoulder and draws in a small breath.*

after2_seo_neck_react_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react_b.text: Hold on a second. Prop this under the papers.

after2_seo_neck_react_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react_c.text: *I pull over a sturdy empty file box stacked in the corner and slide it to the front of Seoyeon's desk.*

after2_seo_neck_touch.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_touch.text: Use an empty file box as a stand, like a bookrest?

after2_seo_neck_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high.text: It's an empty box anyway. The student council president only has one neck.

after2_seo_neck_high_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_high_b.text: You really do know how to land a line so it isn't unpleasant.

after2_seo_neck_high_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_c.text: *Seoyeon pretends to give in and sets the stack of papers on the file box. Raised that much closer to eye level, the angle of her bowed head eases.*

after2_seo_neck_high_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_high_2.text: It is more comfortable than I thought. I'll acknowledge your idea, just for today.

after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.text: All right. Let's finish lining up the rest by date. Leave this box right here. *Close enough that our shoulders might touch, Seoyeon turns the next page.*

after2_seo_neck_low.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low.text: *I quietly set the file box I brought on the corner of the desk between us.*

after2_seo_neck_low_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low_b.text: If it's uncomfortable and you don't want it, you don't have to use it.

after2_seo_neck_low_c.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_c.text: *Without a word, Seoyeon pulls the box over and keeps it right beside her stack of papers.*

after2_seo_neck_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_2.text: I'll finish what I'm on, then try it when I get to the next stack.

after2_seo_9.name: {name}
after2_seo_9.text: *Only around the time the blind's shadow lies long to the far edge of the desk is the thick paperwork nearly finished.*

after2_seo_choice2.name: {name}
after2_seo_choice2.text: *Closing the last folder, I look around the council room, now deep in sunset.*
choices: Should I stay a bit longer? Seems like there's still some left
If we're done, I'll head out
You can finish this much on your own, right?

after2_seo_choice2_trap.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_choice2_trap.text: *She sweeps the remaining stack of papers in toward herself.* Fine. It was my work from the start anyway, so head on back.

after2_seo_stay.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay.text: I'm not keeping you here to make you work. Just because we're done sorting doesn't mean you have to get up right away. *Seoyeon sets her pen down and raises the blind one notch.*

after2_seo_stay_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_2.text: I really like the council room at this hour, once everyone's cleared out. It's quiet.

after2_seo_stay_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3.text: Even the mighty student council president sometimes zones out and rests instead of working?

after2_seo_stay_3b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_3b.text: Yeah. Starting right now, I'm going to rest beside you.

after2_seo_stay_3c.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3c.text: There's one last sheet of the final checklist left? Let's look at just this together, then rest. *I pull the last sheet over beside the clipboard lying face down.*

after2_seo_leave.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_leave.text: *She presses both hands lightly over the neatly ordered stack, squaring it.*

after2_seo_skinship_1.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_1.text: *As I'm about to leave, Seoyeon brushes a speck of dust off my collar, and the soft back of her hand grazes my neck.*

after2_seo_skinship_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_2.text: Don't move. Hold still. ...There, done. *Only after the cleaning cart passes outside the hall do Seoyeon's fingertips slowly let go.*

after2_seo_skinship_3.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_3.text: There was a little loose thread stuck on your collar.

after2_seo_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_high.text: *Dain stops in the gym corridor with a cart of volleyballs as she sees us walking out together.* That student council errand took a while today, huh. *She tightens her grip on the handle and turns away first.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_mid.text: *She stops the ball cart.* All done now? *She glances at Seoyeon beside me, then pushes the cart back into the gym.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_low.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_low.text: Good work, both of you! *She waves energetically over the ball cart, then disappears toward the gym.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_high.text: *Yuna, reading by the landing window, closes her book at the sound of us coming out together. She pulls out the purple note beside her bookmark and silently folds it in half.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_mid.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_mid.text: *Yuna's fingers stop on the open page. She steps aside on the stairs to let us both pass, then quietly opens her book again.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_low.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_low.text: *Standing on the landing, Yuna steps aside and gives us a brief nod.*

after2_yuna_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1.text: *Thinking of the note I got this morning, I head toward the library annex, where few people are around.*

after2_yuna_1_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1_b.text: *Sunset light slants into the annex hall. Not a sign of anyone. Only the secret reading room door in the corner stands open by about two finger widths.*

after2_yuna_2.name: {name}
after2_yuna_2.text: *I push the door, and the hinge gives a low creak. Yuna, settled deep into the sofa, looks up from her book.*

after2_yuna_2_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_2_b.text: *She picks up one white earbud resting on the open page and shifts it a little aside.*

after2_yuna_4.name: {name}
after2_yuna_4.text: You never told me to come after school.

after2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_5.text: Do I have to call you with a note for you to come?

after2_yuna_6.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_6.text: *Yuna's slender index finger slowly traces under the same sentence on the page, twice.*

after2_yuna_7.name: {name}
after2_yuna_7.text: I was just walking past. The door was open a little.

after2_yuna_8.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_8.text: Guess I didn't shut it all the way.

after2_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_8b.text: Don't just stand there. Sit next to me. *One earbud rests on the inner cushion of the sofa. Yuna points with her fingertip at the seat right beside her.*

after2_yuna_8c.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_8c.text: Here. Listen to this with me.

after2_yuna_8d.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8d.text: A soft piano piece. Doesn't the music bother you while reading? *Between us on the sofa, one earbud each, the thin cord pulls taut.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre1.text: *She works a tangle out of the earbud cord with her fingertips and speaks, low.* Someone who comes all the way to this room after school.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3.text: Not a single person since that senior left.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.text: *Yuna looks up over her book and stares at me, still and unrelenting. The earbud cord wound between her pale fingers doesn't move at all.*

after2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after2_yuna_choice.text: *In the narrow space where our shoulders almost touch, the earbud cord around Yuna's fingers cinches one turn tighter.*
choices: Should I come every day?
It's nice because it's quiet.
I like how empty it is here. I would feel comfortable with anyone.

after2_yuna_everyday.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday.text: You say you'll come every day so easily. I never even said you could come every day. *She undoes the earbud-cord knot on her finger and winds it around her index finger again.*

after2_yuna_everyday_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_b.text: Still, if you want to come, come. I won't go out of my way to stop you.

after2_yuna_everyday_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_react.text: But coming every day is a little much. Only sometimes, when you think of it.

after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.text: *The bookmark stays in, and for a while Yuna can't look away from the same page.*

after2_yuna_quiet.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_quiet.text: Yeah. That's why I like it here best, too.

after2_yuna_quiet_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_quiet_react.text: Even with you beside me, I can read without getting distracted. *She moves the bookmark back one page, and still doesn't put the earbud on the sofa away.*

after2_yuna_end.name: {name}
after2_yuna_end.text: I should go before it gets dark. I'll leave the earbud I borrowed here. *I get up from the sofa and pick up my bag.*

after2_yuna_skinship_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_1.text: *I reach out to tidy the book on the table, and my palm settles right over the back of Yuna's cold, pale hand.*

after2_yuna_skinship_2.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_skinship_2.text: ...I wasn't trying to grab it first. You take this book. *Our fingertips overlap in silence for about three seconds before Yuna slowly withdraws her hand.*

after2_yuna_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_3.text: *Yuna draws her hand back, turns the spine toward me so I can take it, and carefully holds the book out.*

after2_yuna_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_high.text: Hey, I said come to the gym, and you escaped to the library annex? You'd better come my way tomorrow!

after2_yuna_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_mid.text: Were you at the library after school today? Make sure you stop by the gym tomorrow!

after2_yuna_rival_dain_low.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_low.text: Oh, you were over by the library annex? Get home safe. See you tomorrow!

after2_yuna_rival_seo_high.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_high.text: So you were at the library annex. Show your face at the council room next time, too.

after2_yuna_rival_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_mid.text: You were in the annex, then. I've finished the urgent council work for today, so I'll see you in class tomorrow.

after2_yuna_rival_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_low.text: The other council members filled in where we were short-handed. See you tomorrow.

after2_group_seoyeon_companion.name: Seoyeon
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.text: *In the council room, she points at two overlapping tasks.* We both need your help. Who will you help first?
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.context: While the protagonist and Seoyeon are sorting the after-school schedule, the other character with the highest affinity arrives with a schedule or request of their own. Student-council work overlaps with another school activity, and the three of them must settle it. Seoyeon clearly asks whom the protagonist will help first.
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.personality: It looks like a small scheduling issue, but both characters are conscious of the protagonist's priority. Keep it from turning into open hostility or humiliation. If the protagonist dodges, each presses for an answer in their own way. If one is chosen, the other does not force a cheerful shrug.
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.groupChoiceState: Seoyeon's schedule overlaps with the companion's request, and the protagonist must say whom he will help first
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the student council room, and why

companionTexts.Dain: *Dain steps closer, fixing her bag strap.* The gym needs your hands too. Can you come with me first?
companionTexts.Yuna: *Yuna turns a note between her fingers.* The annex papers also need sorting today. Will you help my side first?
companionTexts.Teacher: *The homeroom teacher adjusts a paper clip.* There is still an errand for the staff room. Can we take this side first?
companionTexts.Nurse: *The school nurse holds out a small memo.* The nurse’s-office supply check is urgent too. Can you help me first?

after2_group_yuna_companion.name: Yuna
after2_group_yuna_companion.text: *Two bundles of material lie on the annex desk.* There's barely time to finish even one. Who will you stay beside?
after2_group_yuna_companion.context: While the protagonist and Yuna sort material in the library annex, the other character with the highest affinity arrives with separate material or an urgent request. There is only enough time to finish one side properly. Yuna asks, briefly and directly, whom the protagonist will stay beside.
after2_group_yuna_companion.personality: Yuna demands a short, exact choice, while the companion holds their ground in their own voice. Do not force a reconciliation or instantly invent a solution that satisfies both. Let the answer bring relief to one person and disappointment to the other when appropriate.
after2_group_yuna_companion.groupChoiceState: there is time to sort only one of two stacks, so the protagonist must say whose side he will stay on
after2_group_yuna_companion.groupAftermathCause: whose side the protagonist chose in the library annex, and why

companionTexts.Seoyeon: *Seoyeon stands a schedule beside the paper stacks.* The student-council timetable also has to line up today. My side first.
companionTexts.Dain: *Dain taps the desk corner.* Gym cleanup is behind too. Help me first.
companionTexts.Teacher: *The homeroom teacher slides a folder half a step.* There is still an office check left. Can we take this side first?
companionTexts.Nurse: *The school nurse sets down a small box.* The nurse’s-office supplies also need matching today. Will you help me first?

after2_group_dain_companion.name: Dain
after2_group_dain_companion.text: *She grips the ball cart in the gym.* They said to move the event materials from storage first. I was told to get the balls first. What will you check first?
after2_group_dain_companion.context: On the way out, they returned to the gym with Dain to return the ball cart. The companion was asked by the storage attendant to bring festival materials first; Dain heard balls first. Only the order conflicts, with no accident or established liar. With little time left, the player must say whose instruction to verify and help with first.
after2_group_dain_companion.personality: Do not invent a serious accident or malicious lie. The point is not a mystery's objective solution, but whose word the protagonist trusts first. Dain presses honestly, and the companion does not withdraw into a supporting role. Let one person be hurt by the answer when that fits.
after2_group_dain_companion.groupChoiceState: Decide whose instruction to verify and whether to return the ball cart or festival materials first
after2_group_dain_companion.groupAftermathCause: whose account the protagonist believed first in the gym, and why

companionTexts.Seoyeon: *Seoyeon lifts the warehouse papers.* They told me to move the event materials first. Will you check my side first?
companionTexts.Yuna: *Yuna unfolds a short memo.* The warehouse lead asked for the papers first. Will you confirm that first?
companionTexts.Teacher: *The homeroom teacher lifts a printout.* What I got from the staff room put the papers first. Can we check this side first?
companionTexts.Nurse: *The school nurse holds out a small list.* They asked for the supply list first. Will you confirm that first?

after2_group_return.name: {name}
after2_group_return.text: *The talk leaves a faint trace. I hitch my bag up and walk toward the school gate.*

minsu_warn_1.name: {name}
minsu_warn_1.text: *The walk home, sun going down. I've just stepped out the school gate when Minsu strides up from behind and falls in with me.*

minsu_warn_1_b.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_1_b.text: *He matches my pace, lines up beside me, and stuffs both hands in his pockets.*

minsu_warn_4.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_4.text: You having a pretty good time at school these days?

minsu_warn_4_b.name: {name}
minsu_warn_4_b.text: *Minsu doesn't look at me. He only stares at the blinking crosswalk signal across from the gate.*

minsu_warn_5.name: {name}
minsu_warn_5.text: What are you talking about all of a sudden?

hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.text: *She discards the used cotton and presses the edge of the bandage once.* All done. If something besides the injury is bothering you, you can say it now.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.context: It is after school on Day 2, immediately after the nurse treated an injury from PE. The student has seen how attentive the school nurse is, and their trust has grown slightly. Treatment is complete; do not invent a new injury or diagnosis. They remain a school nurse and student, with professional boundaries intact.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is practical and observant, and she softens concern with light humor. She is caring without becoming overprotective and leaves choices about health and feelings to the student.

minsu_warn_6.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_6.text: One at lunch, another after school. Must be fun for you. — Well, that's just how it looks from the side. *He shrugs once, light, and when the signal changes he walks on ahead.*

after2_yuna_trap.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_trap.text: …I thought you meant you liked being with me, not being in this room.

after2_yuna_trap_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_trap_react.text: That just sounded like you're asking if you can bring someone else next time. I never said you could bring just anyone here. *She puts the bookmark back and packs the earphones into her bag.*

after2_seo_cool_1.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_cool_1.text: If you're here, sort the marked list first. *With a businesslike hand, she slides the clipboard over.*

after2_seo_neg_1.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neg_1.text: *She checks only the attendance list and sets the pen down.* Fill only the blanks that need it, then go. Personal talk can wait until tomorrow.

after2_dain_cool_1.name: Dain
after2_dain_cool_1.text: If you're here, pick up the balls scattered on the floor first. Talk after practice.

after2_dain_neg_1.name: Dain
after2_dain_neg_1.text: *She cinches the slack net cord and doesn't even look this way.* I'm practicing alone today. Don't stand there and get in the way.

after2_yuna_cool_1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_cool_1.text: *She only shifts one earbud on the sofa a little aside.* You can read next to me. Just go easy on the talking.

after2_yuna_neg_1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_neg_1.text: *She doesn't close the open book, and she doesn't hand over a single note.* I don't want to be with anyone today.

after2_dain_rival_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after2_dain_rival_seo_neg.text: *She passes in front of the store without a single glance, and she doesn't slow down.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_neg.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna walks toward the annex with her head turned the other way, holding only her book to her chest, and goes right past.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_neg.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_neg.text: *Without a word, she shoves the ball basket hard and goes into the gym. Not even her usual wave.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_neg.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna stands on the landing, book in hand, looking only at the opposite wall. Not even a short nod.*

after2_yuna_rival_dain_neg.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_neg.text: *She snatches up the one volleyball that rolled to the end of the hall and turns her back without a word.*

after2_yuna_rival_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_neg.text: *Attendance book pressed tight to the inside of her arm, she brushes past down the hall. Her shoes never stop once.*

after2_seo_neck_neg.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_neg.text: It's an empty box nobody uses anyway.

after2_seo_neck_neg_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_neg_b.text: *She shoves the box back into the corner where it was.* I don't need a stand. Match the list you were given so it isn't wrong.

after2_seo_neg_leave.name: {name}
after2_seo_neg_leave.text: *I fill only the blanks I was told to, without a word, and step out of the chilly student council room.*

after2_dain_neg_leave.name: {name}
after2_dain_neg_leave.text: *I leave the gym, the air inside gone heavy, and walk alone toward the snack shop.*

after2_yuna_neg_leave.name: {name}
after2_yuna_neg_leave.text: *I quietly pass Yuna's seat, her book still open, and take the annex door handle.*

after2_dain_cool_cont.name: {name}
after2_dain_cool_cont.text: *I pick up the balls in the corner of the court and put them in the basket. Dain looks only at the far net and quietly sets into a serve.*

after2_yuna_cool_cont.name: {name}
after2_yuna_cool_cont.text: *I quietly read down one page of the open book. Yuna puts the earbud she took out back in her ear and turns the page.*

after2_seo_cool_work.name: {name}
after2_seo_cool_work.text: *I start sorting the papers in silence. From the spring-semester event budget drafts to the club applications, there's quite a pile to get through.*
